title: [mergebot] Approve held CI after `merge -r` rebases an outside contributor's PR
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #199190

`@pytorchbot merge -r` force-pushes the rebased commit, and GitHub holds CI of outside contributors for maintainer approval again. trymerge then sees the held checks and fails the merge (e.g. https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/191324), so the maintainer has to approve CI and re-issue the merge.

tryrebase now takes the merge `--comment-id`. For non-ghstack PRs, if the fetched head is the commit the merge command was issued on (same `get_commit_sha_at_comment` trymerge uses), it approves `action_required` runs of the rebased commit for 60s after the push. Commits pushed after the merge comment are never approved. ghstack PRs are unaffected since their authors have write access. Approval failures are logged and don't fail the rebase.

Authored with an AI assistant.

Test plan:

```
cd .github/scripts
python -m pytest test_tryrebase.py
lintrunner .github/scripts/tryrebase.py .github/scripts/test_tryrebase.py .github/workflows/trymerge.yml
```
